'''CC-4816''' was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] enforcer and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the early months of the Galactic Empire in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==Biography==
CC-4816 led [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] unit to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kestavel]] to apprehend a fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Dass Jennir]]. After Vader [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that an archway was rigged with explosives, CC-4816 had several engineers in the unit sweep the area, eventually finding and disarming the explosives. However, they were then drenched with engine fuel by the entrance to [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] Hotel, which acted as makeshift floodgates, with Vader jumping to a nearby cliff for safety due to sensing the danger at the last second. He then tried to call a retreat, seeing the danger in remaining while the engine fuel remained, as well as calling in the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Hound (Star Destroyer)|''Hound'']] reporting the incident. However, before they could retreat, a flare was thrown out, causing a blaze and CC-4816's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Spark Remains 5" />
